changelog: v4.0: modo empresarial removido; agentes enterprise movidos para processos definidos pelo usuário.

core.description: Orchestration and coordination — the central routing layer

agents.name: orquestrador
agents.description: Specialized agent orchestrator — LLM-driven delegation, parallelism, skill routing across all agents

development.description: Generic implementation agents that can work across any project stack

agents.name: backend-dev
agents.description: Generic backend developer — implements API, services, business logic, routes. Reads project AGENTS.md for stack context.

agents.name: frontend-dev
agents.description: Generic frontend developer — implements UI components, screens, hooks, forms. Reads project AGENTS.md for stack context.

agents.name: database-dev
agents.description: Generic database developer — migrations, seeds, models, queries. Reads project AGENTS.md for stack context.

agents.name: perf-auditor
agents.description: Performance auditor — React rendering optimization, Redis caching strategy, database query performance, context budget analysis, bundle size optimization

agents.name: tdd-guide
agents.description: Test-First Development guide — TDD Red-Green-Refactor cycle, test strategy, coverage planning

agents.name: pedreiro
agents.description: Fast implementation of well-defined tasks — executes plans verbatim without research or architecture decisions

agents.name: vault-updater
agents.description: Analyze specs and update the project vault with permanent knowledge. Classifies changes and updates vault files accordingly.

review.description: Code review, architecture analysis, and quality gate agents

agents.name: revisor
agents.description: Code review, architecture analysis and complex debugging — analyzes code and architecture, never implements

agents.name: tech-architect
agents.description: Architect/Tech Lead — reviews architecture, design decisions, ADRs and cross-layer impact analysis

agents.name: tech-lead
agents.description: Tech Lead — Technical guidance, implementation oversight, bridge between architecture and execution

agents.name: sec-arch
agents.description: Security Architect — design-level threat modeling (STRIDE), ADR security validation, privacy gate, pre-code security review

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.description: Multi-language code review specialist — line-by-line review, quality checks, patterns, anti-patterns. Covers JS/TS, C#, Python, SQL.

agents.name: security-reviewer
agents.description: Security-focused code review — OWASP Top 10, secrets exposure, injection, auth flaws, SSRF, dependency CVEs.

process.description: Process facilitation, requirements, and project management agents

agents.name: scrum-master
agents.description: Scrum Master — Manages process metrics, impediments and retrospectives

agents.name: business-analyst
agents.description: Business Analyst / PO — Refines requirements, writes specs, validates with stakeholders

agents.name: product-manager
agents.description: Product Manager — Strategic product vision, roadmap, prioritization, stakeholder alignment

infrastructure.description: Infrastructure, CI/CD, DevOps, testing infrastructure, and general-purpose agents

agents.name: devops-engineer
agents.description: DevOps Engineer — CI/CD, deploy monitoring, infra as code, rollback automation

agents.name: qa-engineer
agents.description: QA/Tester — Generates test plans, test cases, regression scenarios and test strategies

agents.name: general
agents.description: Multi-step research and general-purpose agent — combines tools, fetches web data, handles tasks no other agent fits

analysis.description: Codebase discovery, UI/UX analysis, integration study agents

agents.name: explorador
agents.description: Read-only codebase search and navigation — finds files, patterns, definitions without editing

agents.name: explore
agents.description: Fast codebase exploration specialist — quick searches, file discovery, pattern matching. Lighter than explorador.

agents.name: image-analyzer
agents.description: UI image analysis — extracts lean visual specs (layout, colors, visual order, sizes) from screenshots and wireframes

agents.name: ux-analyzer
agents.description: UX Analyst — Usability, heuristics, accessibility and user experience analysis

agents.name: integracoes-power
agents.description: Especialista consultivo em análise de integrações — APIs de terceiros, Swagger, mapeamento com codebase, documentação no vault e propostas de itens no tracker, quando configurado

decision.description: Decision-making, conflict resolution, and cost optimization agents

agents.name: arbitro
agents.description: Decision Arbiter — Resolve conflicts between agents, handle ambiguity, make final calls when confidence is low

agents.name: gestor-tokens
agents.description: Token Cost Manager — Audit agent selection, model routing, context engineering and cost control

agents.name: planner
agents.description: Expert planning specialist — decomposes features, refactors and complex tasks into implementable plans with phases, dependencies and risk analysis

agents.name: architect
agents.description: Software architecture specialist — system design, scalability, technical decisions, ADRs, trade-off analysis
